The '''''Exchequer''''' was a [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] in service to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Boyse]], the ''Exchequer'' was part of the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]].
